ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Permission to enroll in this course will only be granted to students who are specifically required to take this particular course who need it to graduate before May 2016. Contact nres-ssc@illinois.edu to request permission.
